name: lab-smoke
title: Acceptance: the reader lab's 24-checkpoint Done-When
description: Prove the built estate against the book's Done-When, read-only throughout, run from the platform host and reaching the estate over Nano's transport. Twenty-four checks covering nested virtualisation, the platform, the five networks and jumbo pair, seven VMs answering, the management UI serving, Ceph HEALTH_OK with three mons and six OSDs and the scoped client, the secondary export, both compute hosts, and the zone's observable state -- enabled, system VMs running, two hosts up, a template ready, and a guest whose root volume is genuinely on the production Ceph pool -- plus the snapshot floor. Derived from the framework's proven lab-smoke scenario. On a 32 GB machine live migration (cp15) is excluded by design. Nothing here changes anything.

checks.run: grep -qE '[Y1]' /sys/module/kvm_intel/parameters/nested /sys/module/kvm_amd/parameters/nested 2>/dev/null && echo NESTED-OK
checks.why: The page-one gate: nested virtualisation is on.

checks.run: sg libvirt -c 'export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; systemctl is-active --quiet libvirtd && id -nG | grep -qw libvirt && virsh pool-list | grep -q "lab .*active" && virsh pool-list | grep -q "iso .*active" && test -f /data/iso/noble-server-cloudimg-amd64.img && test -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub && echo PHASE1-OK'
checks.why: Platform host: libvirt up, the reader in its group, both pools active, cloud image and key present.

checks.run: sg libvirt -c 'export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; for n in lab-mgmt lab-storage-fe lab-storage-be lab-guest lab-public; do virsh net-list | grep -q "$n .*active" || exit 1; done && echo NETWORKS-OK'
checks.why: All five libvirt networks are active.

checks.run: ip link show br-lab-stgfe | grep -q 'mtu 9000' && ip link show br-lab-stgbe | grep -q 'mtu 9000' && echo MTU9000-OK
checks.why: The storage pair carries jumbo frames.

checks.run: for ip in 11 21 22 23 31 32 41; do ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new labadmin@10.100.99.$ip hostname; done | tr '\n' ' '
checks.expect_output: mgmt-01 ceph-01 ceph-02 ceph-03 kvm-01 kvm-02 nfs-01
checks.why: All seven VMs answer SSH with the right hostnames.

checks.run: test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://10.100.99.11:8080/client/)" = "200" && echo UI-200-OK
checks.why: The management server is serving (503 fails this).

checks.run: ping -M do -s 8972 -c 3 10.200.99.22 -I 10.200.99.21 >/dev/null && echo JUMBO-OK
checks.why: A 9000-byte frame crosses the storage network unfragmented.

checks.run: sudo cephadm shell -- ceph health
checks.why: Ceph reports HEALTH_OK.

checks.run: test "$(sudo cephadm shell -- ceph -s 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*quorum \([^ ]*\).*/\1/p' | tr ',' '\n' | grep -c .)" -eq 3 && echo QUORUM-3-OK
checks.why: Three monitors in quorum (counted).

checks.run: test "$(sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd stat 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*: \([0-9][0-9]*\) up.*/\1/p')" -eq 6 && echo OSDS-6-UP-OK
checks.why: Exactly six OSDs up and in.

checks.run: test "$(sudo cephadm shell -- ceph osd pool ls 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'rbd-')" -eq 2 && echo POOLS-2-OK
checks.why: Both RBD pools exist.

checks.run: sudo cephadm shell -- ceph auth get client.cloudstack >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo CEPHX-OK
checks.why: The scoped client.cloudstack key exists.

checks.run: sudo cephadm shell -- rbd ls rbd-dev >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo RBD-OK
checks.why: RBD answers on the dev pool.

checks.run: showmount -e localhost 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -qx '/export/secondary' && echo SECONDARY-EXPORT-OK
checks.why: The NFS secondary export is present.

checks.run: egrep -q '(vmx|svm)' /proc/cpuinfo && test -e /dev/kvm && ip link show cloudbr0 >/dev/null && ip link show cloudbr1 >/dev/null && ip link show cloudbr2 >/dev/null && dpkg -s cloudstack-agent 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s qemu-block-extra 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s ceph-common 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && ping -c2 10.100.99.11 >/dev/null && ping -M do -s 8972 -c2 10.200.99.21 >/dev/null && echo KVM01-READY
checks.why: kvm-01: virt, /dev/kvm, three cloud bridges, agent+Ceph packages, both networks incl. jumbo.

checks.run: egrep -q '(vmx|svm)' /proc/cpuinfo && test -e /dev/kvm && ip link show cloudbr0 >/dev/null && ip link show cloudbr1 >/dev/null && ip link show cloudbr2 >/dev/null && dpkg -s cloudstack-agent 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s qemu-block-extra 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && dpkg -s ceph-common 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed && ping -c2 10.100.99.11 >/dev/null && ping -M do -s 8972 -c2 10.200.99.21 >/dev/null && echo KVM02-READY
checks.why: kvm-02: the same; two compute hosts always.

checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "SELECT CONCAT(name,\" \",allocation_state) FROM cloud.data_center WHERE name=\"Manchester\" AND removed IS NULL"'
checks.why: The Manchester zone exists and is enabled.

checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud.vm_instance WHERE type IN (\"SecondaryStorageVm\",\"ConsoleProxy\") AND state=\"Running\" AND removed IS NULL"' | grep -qx 2 && echo SYSVMS-2-OK
checks.why: Both system VMs are Running.

checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud.host WHERE type=\"Routing\" AND status=\"Up\" AND removed IS NULL"' | grep -qx 2 && echo HOSTS-2-OK
checks.why: Both compute hosts are Up in CloudStack.

checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud.template_store_ref WHERE download_state=\"DOWNLOADED\" AND destroyed=0"' | awk '$1>=1{print "TEMPLATE-READY"}'
checks.why: At least one template has finished downloading.

checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud.vm_instance WHERE type=\"User\" AND state=\"Running\" AND removed IS NULL"' | awk '$1>=1{print "GUEST-RUNNING"}'
checks.why: A user guest is Running.

checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cloud.volumes v JOIN cloud.vm_instance i ON v.instance_id=i.id JOIN cloud.storage_pool p ON v.pool_id=p.id WHERE i.type=\"User\" AND i.removed IS NULL AND v.removed IS NULL AND v.state=\"Ready\" AND p.name=\"rbd-prod\""' | awk '$1>=1{print "GUEST-VOLUME-ON-RBD-PROD"}'
checks.why: The guest's own root volume is on the production Ceph pool.

checks.run: test -x ~/lab-snapshot.sh && test -x ~/lab-revert.sh && echo SNAPSHOT-TOOLING-OK
checks.why: The snapshot and revert scripts are installed.

checks.run: sg libvirt -c 'export LIBVIRT_DEFAULT_URI=qemu:///system; virsh snapshot-list --name mgmt-01 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo SNAPSHOT-EXISTS'
checks.why: A baseline snapshot exists -- the drill has been run at least once.
